Headline: Andy Burnham accused of 'turning his back' on Wales over devolution row

Burnham's letter to the First Minister refused to devolve policing and justice, the Crown Estate and rail infrastructure. In his letter he said he was "not persuaded" by the call to devolve policing powers. Rhun ap Iorwerth said Burnham had more influence over policing as mayor of Greater Manchester than he has as First Minister of Wales, and accused the new Prime Minister of "turning his back" on devolution for Wales. Welsh Secretary Stephen Kinnock defended the decision.
